statuses.machine_draft: Machine-assisted draft exists but is not approved for publication.
statuses.human_review: Human-reviewed translation is approved editorially but has not been published yet.
statuses.published: Published translation matches the current Vietnamese source revision.
statuses.stale: Translation exists but its recorded Vietnamese source revision is no longer current.

rules: Vietnamese is the editorial source of truth for registered translation families.
Machine output never becomes published automatically.
A translation may be published only after human review.
Any source revision change makes a previously published translation stale until it is reviewed against the new source.
Missing targets do not require placeholder files or bulk translation.
Translation lifecycle metadata does not grant CMS permissions and does not change public routing.
